key_concepts: Animals are living things found in the surroundings.
Animals live in different habitats such as land, water, or both.
Common animal habitats include homes, gardens, farms, rivers, seas, mountains, and forests
Some animals can be kept as pets at home.
Farm animals include pigs, chickens, goats, ducks, and carabaos.
Animals differ in number of legs; some have two legs and some have four.
Animals have different body coverings such as skin, hair or fur, scales, feathers, and she
Animals move in different ways including walking, crawling, flying, jumping, running, and
Animals use body parts such as legs and wings to move.
Specific animals have distinct traits, such as fish swimming in water and cats having fur
Some animals help people by guarding homes, helping farmers, and providing food.
Animals should be cared for and protected.
